facts.fact: The Cyber Security Authority sanctioned the ORC and Purpleline on 12 August 2026 under the Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038); the article is dated 13 August 2026.
The CSA is stated to treat the Office of the Registrar of Companies as a designated critical information infrastructure institution, directed on 15 June 2026 to engage only licensed providers.

note: Sanctions are not incidents handled or alerts issued, so no response fact.
